question: How many open claims does each Southeast adjuster have?

sql: select a.adjuster_id, a.full_name, a.team, a.leave_date, count(c.claim_id) filter (where c.status='open') open_claims, count(c.claim_id) filter (where c.status='open' and c.region<>'Southeast') open_other_region from adjusters a left join claims c on c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id where a.region='Southeast' group by all order by open_claims desc, a.adjuster_id

select c.region, a.region adj_region, count(*) n, count(*) filter (where a.leave_date is not null) with_left_adj from claims c left join adjusters a using(adjuster_id) where c.status='open' group by all order by 1,2

report.interpretation: Count of claims with status 'open' as of the 2026-09-30 extract, grouped by currently assigned adjuster (claims.adjuster_id), for adjusters whose region is Southeast. Adjusters who have left are included and shown with 0 open claims.
report.answer: Four active Southeast adjusters carry all 206 open Southeast claims: Michelle Hebert (ADJ-018) has 60, Pamela Rojas (ADJ-019) has 54, Patricia Carr (ADJ-021) has 48 and Brittney Watkins (ADJ-020) has 44. Two adjusters who left in May 2026, Theresa Wilson (ADJ-016) and Kayla Rodriguez (ADJ-017), have 0 open claims, so their files have been reassigned.
report.answer_sql: select a.adjuster_id, a.full_name, count(c.claim_id) filter (where c.status='open') as open_claims from adjusters a left join claims c on c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id where a.region='Southeast' group by a.adjuster_id, a.full_name order by open_claims desc, a.adjuster_id

findings.claim: Open claims are concentrated on 4 active Southeast adjusters, with workload ranging from 44 to 60. The two departed adjusters hold none.
findings.evidence_sql: select a.adjuster_id, a.full_name, a.leave_date, count(c.claim_id) filter (where c.status='open') open_claims from adjusters a left join claims c on c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id where a.region='Southeast' group by all order by open_claims desc

charts.title: Open claims by Southeast adjuster
charts.sql: select a.full_name, count(c.claim_id) filter (where c.status='open') as open_claims from adjusters a left join claims c on c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id where a.region='Southeast' group by a.full_name order by open_claims desc
